reconcile.title: Reconcile
reconcile.intro: Match purchase charges against the finance transactions that paid for them.
reconcile.keys.hint: j / k to move · enter to accept · x to reject
reconcile.truncated: Showing the first {{limit}} charges. More arrive as you work through these.
reconcile.empty.title: Nothing is waiting on you
reconcile.empty.hint: Every charge in this filter is already decided or auto-linked. Widen the filter to see the rest.
reconcile.error.title: Could not load the reconcile queue
reconcile.action.caveat: Accepting pins the link so no later sweep revises it. Rejecting only removes the link — nothing records the rejection yet, so the next sweep may propose it again.
reconcile.status.rejected: Link removed. The next sweep may propose it again.
reconcile.entry.noProposals: Nothing proposed — this charge is unexplained.
merchants.title: Merchant spend
merchants.intro: What each merchant was paid, and how much of that a matched charge explains.
merchants.error.title: Could not load merchant spend
merchants.empty.title: No spend in this period
merchants.empty.hint: No order in the selected window reached the roll-up. Widen the period to see the rest.
merchants.period.label: Period
merchants.currency.noTotal: The roll-up gave no total for this currency. The merchants below are still its own figures, so they are shown rather than dropped.
merchants.split.meterLabel: Share of spend explained by a matched charge
merchants.split.overLinked: More has been linked to these orders than they came to, so no share of the total is meaningful.
merchants.attribution.title: How these merchants are grouped
merchants.attribution.name: Grouped by name
merchants.attribution.explain.entity: Grouped on a contacts entity id, the operative identity. The label shown is the one from the group's newest order, ranked as text — a merchant renamed since then can still be wearing its older name (POPS-1854).
merchants.attribution.explain.name: Grouped on the merchant's label because no entity is attached, so this is a label total, not an entity total. Two merchants sharing a label share this row, and renaming one splits its history. No export adapter resolves a merchant entity today, so every exported order lands here (POPS-1852).
merchants.attribution.explain.unattribut: The order names no merchant. Kept as its own group rather than dropped, so the groups still add up to the spend.
merchants.absent.title: Not built below this layer
merchants.absent.tags: Spend broken down by tag needs an aggregate over item tags (POPS-1851).
merchants.absent.items: Line items, per-item buy count and last bought need a product-grain aggregate (POPS-1849).
merchants.absent.inventory: Whether an item is already in inventory needs the inventory fan-out (POPS-245).
receipts.title: Add a receipt
receipts.intro: Photograph a till slip, upload a PDF tax invoice, or paste the text of an order confirmation. Every reading is checked against the total the receipt states before anything is recorded.
receipts.drop.prompt: Drop a receipt here, or choose a file
receipts.drop.accepts: Accepted: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, PDF, or plain text.
receipts.drop.multiPart: A long receipt can be photographed in several frames. Add up to {{max}} of them — they are one purchase, read in the order below.
receipts.text.label: Or paste the receipt text
receipts.text.placeholder: Paste an order confirmation, or the body of a receipt…
receipts.text.empty: There is nothing pasted to add.
receipts.parts.heading: This receipt, in order
receipts.parts.ariaLabel: Parts of this receipt, in the order they will be read
receipts.parts.empty: Nothing added yet. One receipt, in as many parts as it took to photograph it.
receipts.problem.rejected: Not something a receipt can arrive as: {{names}}. Accepted: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, PDF, or plain text.
receipts.problem.tooMany: One receipt is at most {{max}} parts, so {{dropped}} were left out. Remove a part to make room.
receipts.problem.unreadableFile: {{names}} could not be read from this device.
receipts.status.uploading: Reading the receipt. A model is looking at it, which takes a few seconds.
receipts.created.title: Recorded
receipts.created.alreadyStored: These exact files were already in the receipt store, kept from an earlier upload that recorded no purchase. The bytes were not stored a second time.
receipts.created.noDetailView: No page in this app renders a single purchase, so there is nothing to open. The charges from this purchase reach the reconcile queue.
receipts.duplicate.title: Already recorded
receipts.duplicate.intro: Nothing was recorded again, and nothing went wrong: this receipt is already in the system.
receipts.review.title: Read, but it does not add up
receipts.review.intro: Nothing was recorded. Below is what the model read — compare it against the receipt you uploaded and settle which of the two is wrong.
receipts.review.delta: The parts miss the stated total by {{amount}}.
receipts.review.deltaCents: The parts miss the stated total by {{cents}} cents, in a currency the receipt never states.
receipts.review.kind.unreadable-total: The stated total could not be read
receipts.review.kind.unreadable-line: A line could not be read
receipts.review.kind.no-lines: No lines were read at all
receipts.review.kind.sum-mismatch: The parts do not sum to the stated total
receipts.review.kind.ambiguous-tax: The parts add up two different ways
receipts.review.kind.damaged: The receipt is damaged or obscured
receipts.extracted.heading: What the model read
receipts.extracted.unreadableHeading: What the model could not make out
receipts.unreadable.title: Nothing could be read
receipts.unreadable.intro: No purchase was created. The upload was kept, so photographing the receipt again and sending it does not count as a duplicate.
receipts.stored.heading: Stored as
receipts.refused.title: The upload was refused
